  MEETING OF THE
  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  MONDAY, NOVEMBER 21, 2022 AT 6:00 PM
  BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY
  1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Public
Safety Commission with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 3rd Monday of every month at 6:00 p.m.

In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires
modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City at
(626) 300­0735 or at Fire@CityofSanMarino.org at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361)
Members of the Public Safety Commission may teleconference into the meeting without
noticing each teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public
meeting.

  CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID­19) ADVISORY
As a precaution to protect staff, our constituents, and officials, it is recommended that
members of the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s
current Health Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID­19, you are encouraged to
provide input electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person.

How to offer public comment from home:

  1. Public comment will be accepted by email to Fire@CityofSanMarino.org until 3:00 p.m.
  the day of the meeting, to be read during public comment. Lengthy comment may be
  summarized in the interest of time. Any comments received after 3:00 p.m. will be
  included in the public comment record but will not be read at the meeting.

  2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module.
  Zoom comments will be taken after the in­person comments.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Commissioner Jeff Boozell, Commissioner Hunter Chang, Commissioner Elizabeth Feffer, Vice
Chair Charles Martinson, Chair Al Boegh

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman
Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.CityofSanMarino.org.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the Public Safety
Commission by completing a public comment card prior to the meeting. At this time, the
public may address the Public Safety Commission on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the Public Safety Commission may not discuss or take action on
issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.3). The Chair reserves
the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such
items.

COMMISSIONER REPORTS

This is an opportunity for members of the Public Safety Commission to inform the public of
any meetings or conferences they may have attended.

  DEPARTMENT REPORTS

1.  POLICE DEPARTMENT MONTHLY REPORT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission accept and file the Police
  Department Monthly Report.

2.  FIRE DEPARTMENT MONTHLY REPORT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission receive and file the Fire
  Department Monthly Report.

3.  PARKS AND PUBLIC WORKS DEPARTMENT NOVEMBER REPORT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Public Safety Commission receive and file
  this report.

  NEW BUSINESS

4.  APPOINTMENT OF MEMBER TO AD HOC COMMITTEE FOR
  SELECTION OF A CONSULTATION FIRM FOR THE DESIGN/BUILD OF
  THE LACY PARK PLAYGROUND REPLACEMENT
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Public Safety Commission appoint one (1)
  member to the Lacy Park Playground Ad Hoc Committee.

5.  CREATION AND APPOINTMENT OF MEMBER TO SAN MARINO
  TRAFFIC TASK FORCE
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission appoint one member of the
  Public Safety Commission to the San Marino Traffic Task Force.

6.  DISCUSSION REGARDING CHANGING THE LOCATION OF REGULAR
  MEETINGS OF THE PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission discuss changing the location of
  regular meetings of the Public Safety Commission from the Barth Room at Crowell
  Public Library to the City Council Chambers.

7.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES
  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Commission approve the minutes of the
  regular meeting of October 17, 2022.
